mapper.select: select scene_id, project_id, chapter_id, scene_no, scene_title, source_paragraph_from, source_paragraph_to, time_description, location_description, atmosphere, dramatic_goal, character_ids, scene_package_json, status, version_no from ai_video_scene where scene_id = #{sceneId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into ai_video_scene (project_id, chapter_id, scene_no, scene_title, source_paragraph_from, source_paragraph_to, time_description, location_description, atmosphere, dramatic_goal, character_ids, scene_package_json, status, version_no, create_by, create_time) values (#{projectId}, #{chapterId}, #{sceneNo}, #{sceneTitle}, #{sourceParagraphFrom}, #{sourceParagraphTo}, #{timeDescription}, #{locationDescription}, #{atmosphere}, #{dramaticGoal}, #{characterIds}, #{scenePackageJson}, #{status}, #{versionNo}, #{createBy}, now())
